name: dn-printable-vs-utf8-string-valid-rfc5280
description: The permitted directoryName constraint encodes the O attribute value as a PrintableString, the leaf encodes the same character data as a UTF8String. RFC 5280 7.1 requires implementations to compare AttributeTypeAndValue with the LDAP string preparation algorithm, which transcodes PrintableString, UTF8String, BMPString, etc. to Unicode before comparison; the two values are byte-different but Unicode-equal, so the leaf must be considered inside the subtree.
notes: Useful for finding implementations that compare AttributeTypeAndValue by raw DER bytes (tag + length + value) instead of folding the string-type tag away.
